National Research Council Act
Canada Business Corporations Act
subject: Order Authorizing the Incorporation of a Corporation under the Canada Business Corporations Act
precis: Order authorizing the National Research Council of Canada to (1) procure the incorporation of a corporation or to acquire shares of a corporation incorporated to operate the Canadian Photonics Fabrication Centre, any shares of which, on incorporation, are to be held by, on behalf of or in trust for the Crown.
